newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese parliament to vote on budget Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese parliament to vote on budget Dec 11.

text.p: Parliament will vote on the Portuguese government's budget proposals on December 11, parliamentary sources said.
A detailed discussion of the proposals will take place on December 10 and 11, they said.
A plenary debate will take place between November 13-15.
Specialised commissions will hold hearings between October 23 and November 1.

The government presented its 1997 budget proposals, which forecast a sharp rise in revenues and tight control of spending, to parliament on Tuesday, and the budget is expected to be passed by parliament.
